data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 雨中的小憩
data.description: 她躲到屋檐下，从包里找出折叠伞。雨小了一些后，她才继续沿街走。
data.promptProse: Sheltering beneath a glass transit canopy during a sudden downpour, Angelina shakes water droplets from a brightly colored folding umbrella before stowing it into her messenger pack. Outside, rain pools along the curb as passing vehicles kick up misty spray.
data.animaCaption: Shaking the rain from her compact umbrella under the canopy, she checks her messenger bag to make sure all letters stayed dry.
